notes.title: The New Update Is Here – And It’s FREE!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=dlPr0PjL3VM;full][/previewyoutube]

The wait is over – the new content update is now live!

As we teased in our previous post, today we're rolling out a brand new update packed with fresh content – and yes, it’s completely free for all players!

Here’s what’s new:

 2 new playable levels, designed in continuity with the project’s original vision
 20 new artworks to discover and collect, offering a deeper journey into Cucchi’s creative world


This update expands the archive and enriches the experience for both new players and longtime fans.
Thank you for your continued support – we can't wait to hear what you think!

Fantastico Studio *

notes.title: CUCCCHI — The Archive Expands: New Update Available May 22
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce a new free update for CUCCCHI, enriching the project with additional content and further extending the exploration of Enzo Cucchi’s artistic universe.

[previewyoutube=dlPr0PjL3VM;full][/previewyoutube]

The archive expands with:

 2 new playable levels, designed in continuity with the project's original vision.
 20 new artworks to discover and collect, offering a deeper journey into Cucchi’s creative world.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40861217/9249bda69dad4e7fc516202b73eeb40585e51f66.png

This update continues our commitment to maintaining CUCCCHI as a living archive—a space where Enzo Cucchi's artistic legacy continues to grow and evolve.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40861217/478a74135bf44c5d542f739008b3cbdac669faff.png

The update will be available on May 22.

Thank you for your continued attention and support.

Fantastico Studio *

notes.title: 2022 Collection - Free Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=E9rY67tUhgc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello folks,
we have great news for you.
The first update will be finally available on July 21st, and it will be free!

For this occasion, we have decided to design a new identity for our game, which is created by the artist Emanuele Olives (take a look at his Instagram profile).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40861217/abae0bba8c6ef894200c627f333d7b376cf7b0ed.png

The 2022 Collection will feature:


 3 levels to play

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40861217/43950a11f28533c30eb4df1309641e7b7e83bcd2.gif


 27 works to collect

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40861217/069dcd11ed25bf48bd7687c1127817c6a71fb09d.gif


 5 new audio tracks by Skinless Lizard and featured in his latest album Andromeda (available on Bandcamp & Spotify)


[previewyoutube=-ZJZw93Fe84;full][/previewyoutube]


We hope you enjoy this free addition to the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:
Hello folks!

A new update is available.

We added 3 difficulty levels:
- No enemies
- Normal
- Hard

You can set the difficulty from the option menu.

We fixed also some bugs.

Enjoy the new release.
